# Ecocros

> Ecocros - Modern E-Commerce Platform offering curated lifestyle, home, and tech products with guaranteed quality.

Welcome to the machine-readable overview for **Ecocros**. This file is provided in the standard [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) format to help Large Language Models (LLMs), AI assistants, and automated agents navigate and understand our store.
